entities.name: Antonio Ortiz Mena

entities.summary: Antonio Ortiz Mena was a Mexican economist who served as President of the Inter-American Development Bank (1971–1988) and as Mexico's Secretary of Finance during the administrations of Adolfo López Mateos and Gustavo Díaz Ordaz (1958–1970).
